ones = [0] * 20
for i in range(1, 17):
    ones[i] = ones[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def count_ones(n, i):
    total_ones = 0
    while i > 0:
        block = ones[i]
        times = n // block
        total_ones += times * i
        n %= block
        if n == 0:
            break
        total_ones += min(i + count_ones(ones[i] - n, i - 1), count_ones(n, i - 1))
        break
    return total_ones
